comparison.objective: Kit robot-joint parts into a shaped tray; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper in place.
comparison.physical_skill: Part recognition, grasping, and shape-matched placement versus tool use, unlocking, fine adjustment, relocking, and physical test cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Correct parts occupy tray locations versus two safe stops with no bottoming, overload, rebound, or setting drift. PR lacks detailed placement thresholds.
comparison.reason: The robot context is shared, but the tested abilities and outcomes are not.
